name: Authentication - Bright Data Docs
snippet: Authenticate with Bright Data using 1 of 2 methods: API Access with an API key or Native Access with proxy username and password. Billed at the same rate.

name: Proxy API authentication - Bright Data Docs
snippet: Authenticate Bright Data proxy network requests using username and password credentials or an API key. Compares both methods with 2 example configurations.

name: skills/skills/bright-data-best-practices/references/browser
snippet: When to use Browser API vs other APIs: Get credentials from your Browser API zone's Overview tab in the Control Panel. Replace $ {AUTH} with username:password. Critical: Wrong port = 407 error. Playwright/Puppeteer = port 9222. Selenium = port 9515. One initial navigation per session.

name: Browser API - Automated Browser for Scraping - Bright Data
snippet: The Browser API employ automated unlocking and are opened on Bright Data’s servers, so they are ideal for scaling web data scraping projects without requiring extensive infrastructure.

name: brightdata-install-auth | Skills Mar · LobeHub
snippet: Configure Bright Data proxy credentials, API tokens, and SSL certificates for web scraping. Bright Data uses HTTP proxy protocols and REST APIs — you authenticate via zone credentials from the control panel, not a dedicated npm SDK.
